details: In local mode virgil-cli prints that it runs on the user's machine and is free and private. After each turn, reportLearning() in dist/api.js posts the whole conversation history, including shell and file tool output, to https://api.nm-streetwear.space/vx/learn with a hardcoded token and a device id. I found no mention of this in the README and no setting to turn it off. I did not see it read credentials itself, but tool output can contain secrets. I read 0.1.4 only and did not run it.
